events.title: Return of HF News
events.description: Scribe has become the new home for Writ3rs on the forum and will be bringing monthly editions of the Hack Forums News, trimmed down to focus on material about the site itself.

events.title: Bytes Bonus Days
events.description: Until June 5th, upgraded members gain bonus bytes for posts and threads in celebration of HF's official holiday "Goodwill Monday" — L33t members earn 1.5x and Ub3r members earn 2x normal values.

events.title: Anniversary of Hack Forums
events.description: Hack Forums celebrated its 16th anniversary with a new award goal: King Decade for members who have been on the site for 10+ years.

events.title: Users Viewing Threads
events.description: Ub3r and V3ndor members can now view which users are viewing a thread. Non-upgraded and L33t members lost the ability to view the Who's Online list.

events.title: Group & Crew Sales/Purchases
events.description: Olympians was purchased by Neil. Succubus listed for sale by SecretAchiever101. Marketers listed for sale by -Scrub. Revenge listed for sale by Trappy. Red Lions crew purchased by B3A. BlackCats crew listed for sale by Zexo. Cult crew listed for sale by uid 4963606. Mafia crew listed for sale by T0fu.

events.title: Crew Fees Increased
events.description: After complaints, the price to update details for a Crew has been raised to 50,000 Bytes per change, bringing a complete rebrand cost to 100,000 bytes total.

events.title: Posts, prestige, and reputation milestones
events.description: Hydra reached 12,000 posts; Biggy reached 100 B-Rating; oRequiem is one thread away from 500 threads; Cooligan reached 300 B-Rating; Mr Monero reached 1,000 posts; Hopsin reached 500 threads; Nostre reached 8,000 posts; InspectorGadget reached 1,000 popularity; 【﻿ＯＭＥＧＡ】 reached 1,000 posts.

events.title: Bans
events.description: Ph4n70M Phr34K was banned for 14 days by Omniscient ("Take a break from HF.", returned 05/24/2023). N1ghtm4re was banned for 7 days by Genuine for an invalid deal dispute (returned 05/27/2023). A number of skids spamming and evading were also banned.

events.title: Vacation bans
events.description: xHeaven and SIM-587985 took brief vacation bans and have already returned.

events.title: Awards
events.description: source earned the Black Hatter award. SourceCode101 earned the White Hat Helper award. DemonAsylum earned the Molten Sword of Hackúman award.

events.title: Signatures and Custom Groups
events.description: Changes were made to reduce the requirements preventing non-upgraded members from displaying their signatures on their profiles.

events.title: Hackúman Season 1 Winner
events.description: DemonAsylum won Hackúman season 1, becoming the second user to receive the Molten Sword of Hackúman award.

events.title: Custom Groups and Bytes
events.description: After months of low-quality spam in custom usergroups, the ability to earn bytes through those subforums has been removed; bytes from posts/threads are now earned only in the public forum.

events.title: Bytes History Filters
events.description: Users can now change views when looking at their Bytes History to filter by wins/losses, donations, bumps, and other transfers and purchases.
